request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Which devices will run out of disk within the next week if nothing changes?","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"insight","restated_question":"Which devices in acme-001, based on their disk usage trend over the 30-day telemetry window, are projected to reach full disk (or the policy's critical disk threshold) within the next 7 days if current growth continues?","assumptions":["'Run out of disk' means reaching the policy-defined critical/full disk threshold, taken from get_policy rather than assumed.","The projection relies on the disk_trend detector's deterministic forecast, not on manual arithmetic.","Devices already below the low-disk threshold are included as context via disk_low.","The forecast assumes the current fill rate continues ('if nothing changes')."],"steps":[{"tool":"get_policy","purpose":"Retrieve the disk thresholds and trend projection definitions that define 'running out of disk'."},{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run the disk_trend and disk_low detectors to find devices projected to exhaust disk within 7 days, along with those already critically low."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
